info.description:
Provide students the definitions, organization and management for hospitality industry

This course helps students analyze every factors impact to revenue stream
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Students can capture and respond to a wide variety of customer needs in the field of revenue management; understand the revenue stream from various sources in hotels and restaurants. Link this subject knowledge with other subjects of hospitality management. In addition, due to the subject complexity, this subject emphasizes the importance of  revenue monitor task of  in the organization.
Students acquire important skills: monitoring skills, risk exposure, analysis skills, problem solving skills, organizational planning and management skills.
Students can analyze the revenue stream; identify the factors impact to revenue and make the revenue forecast.
Students are trained to perform professional ethics; have the spirit and professional service attitude; forming the love of work and the spirit of professional service staff.
